title: Freeze regression inputs
responsibility: Keep test inputs fixed between the failing-test commit and its fix.

inputs.name: testPath.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative path to classify as a test, fixture or scenario input.

inputs.name: metadata.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative path to classify as loop metadata or Markdown documentation.

inputs.name: regressionFiles.root
inputs.description: Repository containing the selected committed test corpus.

inputs.name: regressionFiles.commit
inputs.description: Exact commit whose tests, fixtures and runner configuration are fingerprinted.

inputs.name: regressionFiles.tests
inputs.description: Named strengthened tests that must exist in the committed corpus.

inputs.name: regressionFixCommit.root
inputs.description: Repository containing both the red checkpoint and candidate repair.

inputs.name: regressionFixCommit.commit
inputs.description: Candidate fix commit whose ancestry, source-only repair and frozen test inputs are checked.

inputs.name: regressionFixCommit.red
inputs.description: Retained failing record identifying the original test commit and frozen corpus.

inputs.name: regressionTestCommit.root
inputs.description: Repository containing the candidate failing-test checkpoint.

inputs.name: regressionTestCommit.commit
inputs.description: Commit checked for a test-only change before any product repair.

inputs.name: regressionTestCommit.tests
inputs.description: Named tests that the failing-test commit must strengthen.

outputs.name: Result
outputs.description: The frozen test inputs, or why the commit sequence is invalid

errors.name: Invalid proof
errors.description: Refuses a product repair in the test commit, reused commits or changed test inputs.
